dataList.content:
Entering Daguanyuan now!
轿至，大观园！

Despite some troubles on the way, it seemed that we managed to arrive at our destination mostly unhurt.
虽然途中经历了众多艰难曲折……但不知不觉间，我们似乎抵达了目的地。

Daguanyuan, Hong Lu's old home.
鸿璐曾生活过的，名为大观园的地方。

Oof, we’re running out of time.
哎呀，时间所剩无几了呢。

Faust, I'm sure you understood the most important part of my plan, right?
浮士德女士。你已经理解了我的作战核心吧？

It is... unlikely to be a pleasant sight to behold.
我估计……不会是什么赏心悦目的景象。

Remember, the plan hinges on your patience, everyone. You have to remain calm and wait, even if they freak out and actively try to kill you.
核心就是即便他们要取你性命，也要不慌不忙地等待。

There is a chance that they might panic and immediately order for the Sinners to be executed on the spot. However, it is unlikely that the person whose responsibility is to judge the next Family Hierarch of Hongyuan will make such a hasty response.
他们也有可能惊慌失措地下令处理掉我们。不过，负责鸿园家主评审之人的魄力应该不会只有如此程度。

Exactly. Everything's going to be fine as long as the decider has the capacity for patience.
没错呢。只要对方的器量足够大的话。

Nnh? Execution? Wha?
哈？杀掉？在说啥？

Great. I'll follow up with a subsequent contact once you've safely completed the first round of the evaluations.
那么下次联络……就在第一轮顺利结束之后吧。

After that cryptic exchange with Faust, Saude leaped gracefully off the moving palanquin as Heathcliff murmured in his half-sleep.
在神秘兮兮的对话结束后，索德便如流水般灵巧地跳下了轿子，只留下希斯克利夫那半梦半醒的声音。

We watched her grow smaller and smaller as the distance between us grew, but what really caught our eyes were the scattered humans that the Restructuring Day had evicted from their homes. They were trying to drag their broken bodies off the road, sobbing and writhing.
……在她所远去的方向上，被重构日所驱逐的人们四处遭人践踏、伏行于地面抽泣的景象，不断展现在我们眼前。

This… is horrible. There isn’t anything we can do to help, but...
真是残酷啊……虽然我们大概也爱莫能助……

Such sense of futility and powerlessness will negatively impact the efficient performance of your professional obligations.
这种无力感会影响作业效率。

Repeated exposure to similar stimuli is recommended to desensitize oneself to this sensation.
建议你重复经历以习惯这种感觉。

S-so Hong Lu, how do you feel about going back home after so long?
鸿、鸿璐先生，你回家后感觉如何？

Sinclair changed the subject.
辛克莱抛出了个不同的话题。

Hmm… I don’t know...
嗯……这个嘛……

Don’t even need to ask him, lad. I know it can’t be easy.
不用说吧？……肯定很复杂。

As for me... blimey, I hesitated almost a thousand times, wonderin' if I should just turn around and leave.
对于我来说，想了上百次要不要中途折返。

What if I knocked on those gates, but she, she—
要是敲门后，她却将我……

Heathcliff came to a suffocating stop, his voice trembling lightly as he did so.
希斯克利夫说着像是被哽住般停下了。

The other Sinners stared at him in confused silence.
罪人们一脸莫名其妙的表情，就那样盯着希斯克利夫。

What, what is it? Why’d you stop in the middle of a—
怎么了，为什么话说一半不说……

<Um… wow, look at these cool windows. I think we can swap them out with other images!>
<嗯……看这里的窗的背景~好像可以切换成别的耶？！>

Sigh...
唉……

I quickly tried to swerve from this subject again, but all I got was Ishmael’s scolding glare that seemed to wordlessly tell me “not the time!”.
急于转移大家注意力的我只得到了以实玛利投来的“现在不是说这话的场合”的责备眼神。

Fuhu, I remember.
呼呼，我记起来了。

I remember what happened each time one of us returned to the part of the City that held our memories. Memories of happiness... anger... sorrow... and joy. And as we traveled, I remember that they were all looking at sceneries only they could see.
当我们前往承载着各自喜怒哀乐的都市时，大家都在巴士上眺望着只有各自所能见到的风景呢。

Rodya, you awkwardly tried your best to crack jokes.
罗佳小姐一直在尽力开拙劣的玩笑。

Sinclair, you tried your best to hold back the welling tears, again and again.
辛克莱先生好几次都在强忍着泪水。

Yi Sang, you shut your eyes for a long, long time.
李箱先生很长时间都闭着双眼。

Ishmael, you couldn’t stop talking to yourself while glaring down at the lake’s surface.
以实玛利小姐注视着大湖的水面，不断在自言自语……

And Heathcliff, I saw you scared and anxious, shaping your hair over and over again.
希斯克利夫先生不断畏怯而又焦急地摸着头发。

<You've really been... watching us closely, huh.>
<你……观察得相当细致呢。>

Did... we?
我们……有这样吗？

Spring leaves, petals scatter, and all shall turn around to find the doors to which they belong and return forevermore.
三春去后诸芳尽，各自须寻各自门。

I think everyone has a small mound of petals they gathered for themselves.
我呢，一直觉得每个人都有自己收集的花瓣。

... What? I don't. Why would anyone collect somethin' like that?
……我没有啊？为啥要收集那玩意？

Then you simply haven't discarded them yet.
那你只是还没有把它们散去而已。

There was still a transparent smile on his face, but I think I saw a burying, sinking shadow behind it.
鸿璐的脸上仍然漂浮着他那近乎透明的笑容，但在那笑容后我似乎见到了其投下的黯淡残影。

The moment I felt that, a familiar light came into view.
有了那种感觉的瞬间，视野突然被熟悉的光芒所覆盖。

And I immediately understood what was going on.
我立刻反应过来发生了什么。

The Golden Bough is close, and it is resonating with Hong Lu's fathoms.
金枝将近，我与鸿璐的心象发生了共鸣。

dataList.content:
So please, don't scatter all the petals from your embrace, big bro Baoyu.
所以宝玉哥哥，请别让你怀中的花瓣尽数散去。

<Hong Lu...>
<鸿璐……>

<Is there anyone you miss here at Daguanyuan?>
<你在大观园有想见的人吗？>

Hmm…
嗯……

No, there isn't.
不，没有。

… But how's that possible? Isn’t your family there…? And… a bunch of other people who are so important to you…?
……你为什么会这么说呢？那儿应该有很多你的家人……重要的人才对……

Well, as long as I believe them to be doing well…
这个嘛，只要我相信他们过得很好……

… there isn’t any need for me to yearn to see them again.
就没有对他们心怀思念的理由。

<Do you still... treasure your petals?>
<你仍珍重着你的那些花瓣……吗？>

No. I scattered them all the day I departed my home.
不。我离家之时，就已经将它们散尽了。

So my rainy days are now silent.
所以，如今每逢雨日，我便听不到声音。

<I see... >
<原来如此……>

You saw that, didn't you? Dante.
您看到了对吧？但丁阁下。

You saw my memory.
我的记忆。

Hehe.
呼呼。

Hong Lu laughed. He wasn't surprised or angry that I peered into his memories.
鸿璐只是在微笑。他并未因自己的记忆被窥视而感到震惊或是愤怒。

Uhm...
嗯……

Do you want to tell us about your parents? Or, uh… yeah, you talked about your grandmother pretty often, right? What kind of people are they... ?
鸿璐先生的父母是什么样的人呢？或者说说……你经常提到的那位奶奶……

Sinclair added carefully.
辛克莱小心地继续说道。

Maybe he was trying to commiserate, tenuous as that connection might've been. We were headed to his home to meet his family, anyway.
或许他在试图抓住哪怕只有一点的和鸿璐的共感之处。因为是正在去家人所在的家的路上。

Ah, they are both very wise in the ways of the world.
他们二位都是非常明理的人。

Grandmother always treated me preciously.
奶奶一直很疼爱我。

So did my mother, and my father.
母亲，还有父亲也是如此。

Uh, uhm...
啊，呃……

Ah, we're almost there.
啊，我们马上到了。

I can see the garden.
我已经看到园子了。

<This is one massive garden...>
<光是园子就够大的了……>

We still have some time before we get to the main buildings.
离到达主宅还有一段路。

I remember the days when deer and hares would frolic out here in the garden, fuhu.
我还记得以前小鹿和兔子在这园子里跑跑跳跳玩耍的日子，呼呼。

Well, I can see myself taking a long walk around here. It’d take a whole day and then some to cover the entire ground...
要想在这散步的话，大概要花一整天才能走完吧……

I usually lingered only around my own room. It’s dangerous to stray too far, after all.
我一般只在自己住的房间周围走动。别的地方从各种方面来说都很危险。

<It’s dangerous? Why?>
<危险？为什么？>

There's the stranger danger, getting lost, getting targeted... Besides, it's very dark at night.
走错路的话可能会遇见意想不到的人~也可能会成为别人的目标。夜里太黑，什么也看不见呢。

Well, that ain’t a very big deal, is it? Kids run around, scrape their faces on the branches, trip and eat shite on the pavement all the time.
什……孩子们在园子里到处乱跑的时候可能会摔破膝盖，被枝条划伤脸啥的。

Hehe, I’m sure you would’ve run freely around the garden, Heathcliff. But it's important to always be careful.
呼呼，要是希斯克利夫先生你的话应该可以自由地奔跑吧。但还是要经常小心。

When I was five, someone had lathered a deadly poison on a random tree branch.
我五岁的时候，有人在树枝上涂了致命的剧毒。

Ack... poison?!
呜欸……下毒吗？！

I had a little brother who liked to frolic like you do, Heathcliff.
我曾有个和希斯克利夫先生一样喜欢跑跳的弟弟……

But by some coincidence, he happened to be running around the same tree that had its branches lathered with poison.
偶然间，周围的树枝上被涂上了毒。

What… what hath transpired thereafter?
此……此后他如何了？

I'm sure he got better.
应该已经好了吧。

Xiren told me he’ll be just fine after a hundred nights' rest.
袭人告诉我说他只要睡上一百天就会好起来的。

And because Xiren was always so smart, I'm sure it happened exactly as she said.
袭人一直以来都很聪明，所以一定是那样的。
